identified_issues: Sticky top bar obscured scrolled content on iPhone Safari
Bottom navigation was oversized and inherited boxed icon styles
Mobile content needed reliable clearance above fixed navigation
Safari dynamic viewport and keyboard states were not handled
Tablet portrait widths between 821 and 1024 pixels retained the desktop sidebar
Mixed Persian and German text needed safer wrapping and bidi handling

fixes.ios_header: Non-sticky compact header on mobile and tablet
fixes.bottom_navigation: 58-60px navigation with safe-area padding and reset icon styles
fixes.dynamic_viewport: VisualViewport-based height variable and keyboard detection
fixes.forms: 16px iOS inputs to prevent focus zoom
fixes.content_clearance: App shell and body reserve navigation plus safe-area height
fixes.tablet_layout: Two-column tablet grids and full-width tablet shell
fixes.text_rendering: 100% text-size adjustment, plaintext bidi and overflow wrapping
fixes.more_sheet: Safe-area-aware modal sheet with outside-click dismissal and corrected stacking

representative_render_acceptance.engine: Headless Chromium with representative production shell

device_acceptance_note: A post-release screenshot from real iPhone Safari is still required to verify browser-specific chrome and cache behavior on the user's device.
